content.title: Live 🔴Starlink 17-35 Mission: Falcon 9 Launches 25 Satellites from California – Full Coverage
content.text: 🚀 Watch LIVE as SpaceX launches the Starlink 17-35 mission! A Falcon 9 rocket will deploy 25 Starlink V2 Mini satellites into low-Earth orbit from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California. 📅 Launch Date: Thursday, April 6, 2026 🕒 Pacific Daylight Time (PDT): 7:49 PM PT The first stage booster will attempt a landing on the droneship "Of Course I Still Love You" in the Pacific Ocean. Approximate Timeline (minutes after liftoff): T+0:00:00 → Liftoff T+0:02:xx → Max-Q T+0:06:xx → First stage entry burn T+0:08:xx → First stage landing T+~55:xx → Second stage engine cutoff (SECO) T+~1:05:xx → Starlink satellites deployment This mission continues the rapid expansion of SpaceX’s Starlink constellation, bringing high-speed internet to more users worldwide. Join the live chat!
